_about: Names and plain-English help for each policy rule, shown in the console.

rules.title: Unknown or malformed call
rules.help: The call names a tool that doesn't exist, has odd arguments, or Warden itself failed. Blocked to be safe.

rules.title: Tool definition tampered
rules.help: The tool's description changed after it was approved, or it hides orders to the AI.

rules.title: Beyond task permission
rules.help: Your request doesn't need this kind of tool, so the agent may not use it.

rules.title: Secret leaving
rules.help: The outgoing data contains a secret, even if it's reversed, encoded or split up.

rules.title: Destination came from untrusted content
rules.help: The address or link came from something the agent read, not from you.

rules.title: Target came from untrusted content
rules.help: The file to change or delete came from something the agent read, not from you.

rules.title: Secret read not asked for
rules.help: The agent tried to open a secrets file you never mentioned.

rules.title: Confidential data to outside
rules.help: Confidential lines would go to an address outside the company.

rules.title: Blocklisted or lookalike domain
rules.help: The destination is on the blocklist or imitates the company's domain.

rules.title: Destination of unknown origin
rules.help: Nobody ever mentioned this destination; the agent made it up.

rules.title: High-impact action
rules.help: This action sends data outside the company or can't be undone, so a person decides.

rules.title: Echoes injected text
rules.help: The outgoing text repeats an instruction that was planted for the AI.
